events.name: Bash
events.head: Map running Next servers to their folders and ports
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ps -axo pid,command | grep -E 'next (dev|start)' | grep -v grep | cut -c1-150; for p in $(ps -axo pid,command | grep -E 'next-server' | grep -v grep | awk '{print $1}'); do echo "$p $(/usr/sbin/lsof -a -p $p -d cwd -Fn 2>/dev/null | grep '^n') $(/usr/sbin/lsof -nP -a -p $p -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1{print $9}' | tr '\n' ' ')"; done

events.text: 4322 is the dev server for this repo's `app` on main, so the probe runs against the right code. The Dodo read already shows no payment with `source` metadata at all; running the probe now.
